prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Houston, Texas, and has shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1473; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to talk with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision at the intersection in Houston, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give my first name, if that's okay. It's the same as the policy holder's, so it's easy to confirm.

Q: That works. Can you walk me through what happened before the impact?

A: I was heading through the intersection on a green light. I had slowed a bit because traffic was backed up on the cross street, but the signal was green when I entered.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the collision?

A: Not clearly. I saw something coming from my right, but it came out faster than I expected. I braked, but there wasn't time to avoid it.

Q: Where did the impact hit your vehicle?

A: The driver's side door, right where I'm sitting. The airbags on that side went off and the car spun a little before stopping.

Q: Did you get out of the vehicle right away?

A: I got out with some help. My left shoulder was hurting pretty badly, and I still have trouble lifting my arm above my head. I went to an urgent care clinic that same afternoon.

Q: Have you received any treatment since then?

A: I've been going to physical therapy twice a week and I have a follow-up with an orthopedic doctor next month. The pain wakes me up at night sometimes.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I was careful and followed the signal. I just want my shoulder taken care of and my car repaired.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
